data.content:
The Cripple Creek & Victor Narrow Gauge Railroad takes visitors through one of Colorado's best-known historic gold mining districts. Its short excursion passes old mines and follows part of the former Midland Terminal railroad corridor near Cripple Creek. Unlike some longer mountain railroads, this attraction concentrates its mining history and scenery into an approximately 45-minute experience. [...] SplashTravels

# Historic Mining Railroads That Can Still Take You Into The Mountains Today

November 14, 2026 | Jane O'Shea

# Historic Mining Railroads That Can Still Take You Into The Mountains Today

## When The Mines Closed, The Trains Kept Climbing [...] The Royal Gorge Route Railroad follows a historic corridor originally developed during Colorado's late nineteenth-century silver mining boom. Competition for access to the Leadville mining district triggered a bitter struggle between the Denver & Rio Grande and Atchison, Topeka & Santa Fe railroads. Today's passenger excursions travel through the dramatic Royal Gorge, where the Arkansas River cuts between towering canyon walls.
